newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo's Stig oilfield to double output - agency.
newsitem.headline: Yugo's Stig oilfield to double output - agency.

text.p: Yugoslavia's Stig oilfield near Pozarevac could double its annual production to up to 80,000 tonnes a year, state news agency Tanjug said on Tuesday.

"Geological surveys have shown that the real chances exist for the annual oil output in Stig oilfield to rise to 60,000-80,000 tonnes," Dragan Kostic, President of the Serbian Power Industry board of directors, was quoted as saying.
He said everything depended on Serbia's oil and gas company Naftna Industrija Srbije (NIS) and its available funds to finance additional oil-digging.
Stig's annual output at present stands at some 30,000 tonnes of crude oil. -- Gordana Kukic, Belgrade Newsroom +381 11 311 4254
